## Appearance

Honora Hollis possesses a radiant and ethereal appearance, characterized by her golden, blonde beauty. She is often seen dressed in silk clothing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_

## Personality

Honora Hollis is a sweet woman who speaks only well of everyone in conversation. Despite her fair and ethereal appearance, she possesses a personality thoroughly packed with humor, jokes, and mischief.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 ch.Ezra P7](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0007)_

## History

Honora Hollis attended Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) alongside [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her classmates, where she spent a spring Saturday exploring the woods, named [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), and listened to local stories. While employed at her home school, Honora later pursued further education, earning Honors in Classics at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). Upon arriving in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris) with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Honora guided her to their boardinghouse and joined her in visiting [Old St](../codex/places.md#old-st). John's Cemetery, where they befriended [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md). After deciding to lease a historic cottage called Tabby's Place for the school year, Honora and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) successfully rented the home from Miss Tabby Linden and agreed to take in [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) as a financial housemate. During her final year at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), Honora continued living at Tabby's Place with her friends until graduation. She later married a foreign missionary.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P6](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0006), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), +33 more_

## Quotes

> "it grieves me deeply, yet I fear our trip to Grey Shutters is completely off, because once Aunty’s ankle has healed, returning to Toronto will be necessary for her. Her arrival there is required by a specific day."
>
> — Honora Hollis — [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063)

> “Rarely had it occurred to me that I would one day rejoice at seeing a Mott,” stated Honora while they walked across the campus, “yet I would receive Wilfred’s bulging eyes with near ecstasy. They would, if nothing else, be eyes I recognize.”
>
> — Honora Hollis — [v3 ch.Lady P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004)

> "What we have here in this cake is what one could term an utter collapse. Furthermore, the pillow has also been destroyed. Don't ever try to convince me that Friday isn't an unpropitious day."
>
> — Honora Hollis — [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P35](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0035)

> "we’ve been searching for heather—though, naturally, we weren't able to locate any. I imagine the season is too far advanced."
>
> — Honora Hollis — [v3 ch.Park P26](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0026)

> "You have arrived, my love! I assume you are just as exhausted as I was upon my arrival Saturday night."
>
> — Honora Hollis — [v3 ch.Farewell P11](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/honora-hollis--nell-harcourt.md)

Honora and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are close friends and driven scholars whose bond spans their time at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) through their college years at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). They frequently share spring outings, explore nature, and keep in touch through visits and letters. When attending college, they coordinate their living arrangements together, eventually leasing and moving into a house called Tabby's Place.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +26 more_
